title: gentianella obtusifolia
intro: Gentianella obtusifolia, commonly known as Rough gentian, is a species of flowering plant in the family Gentianaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, colds, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Gentianella obtusifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of relieving pain, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Gentianella obtusifolia include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
